- All major sources (bookmaker, market, model) aligned on home favorite
- Bookmaker has extreme away probability (5.4%) vs market (15.9%), Sportmonks (19.5%), Supabase (16.4%)
- This suggests bookmaker may be overconfident on home or market pricing is sharper
- The 50% uncertainty level seems reasonable given the spread across sources, and there are no conflicting signals to worry about. The missing data flags appear outdated since lineups are already confirmed. Everything points toward a home win with consistent probability estimates across independent sources, making this a solid candidate for backing the favorite despite the moderate confidence score.
